translated_title: Supreme Court Denies Calica’s Injunction and Validates the Navy as Coast Guard in Mexico’s Ports
original_title: SCJN niega amparo a Calica y valida a la Marina como Guardia Costera en puertos del país
author: Iván Evair Saldaña
meta_description: The Court unanimously upheld the Navy’s coast-guard powers over ports, rejecting a challenge by Calica, a subsidiary of U.S.-based Vulcan Materials, at its Punta Venado terminal in Quintana Roo.
